page: Microsoft Azure D16d_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a 614 GB local SSD, while there are no integrated GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations place the D16d_v5 in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1898.68 and a multi-core score of 15521.76, supported by hardware-accelerated instructions such as AVX-512 and cryptography extensions. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only cached small-block bandwidth of 832.64 GB/sec and an uncached large-block write speed of 38.08 GB/sec. In application-level tests, the server demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 17.85 GB/sec and handles 15.33 million Redis SET operations per second.

This configuration offers a balanced resource density, combining compute, memory, and high-speed local SSD storage without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The inclusion of local SSD storage makes it highly suitable for workloads requiring fast temporary scratch space or caching. Recommended workloads include relational databases, web serving, application servers, and moderate data processing tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure D16d_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the DDv5 family, powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs, 64.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 614 GB local SSD. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this x86_64 server delivers balanced compute and memory resources. Benchmark results show average performance, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 15521.76 and a static web serving throughput of 17.85 GB/sec. The system supports advanced vector and cryptographic instructions, including AVX-512 and AES. With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated high-speed local storage, the D16d_v5 provides a cost-efficient platform for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for database hosting, web serving, and application backend deployments that benefit from fast local temporary storage.
